summary.prose: Retain the implemented shared external Node foundation, bootstrap handoff and application-only bundle/dev consumers, with the existing ten-task ordering and accepted T1–T9 work unchanged. The final evidence task now requires actual macOS/Linux native qualification, current scoped regression evidence and unqualified-target exclusion before foundation BUILD approval and S4 handoff. The original Windows native subject is deferred and remains required before future Windows enablement; it is never credited from POSIX results or metadata. Retained evidence keeps exact source pins and is reused only with recorded relevant source and closure equivalence.

tasks.title: Pin deterministic runtime profiles and integrity metadata
tasks.summary: Extend the existing private policy with deterministic distribution profiles, official archive byte counts and independently derived Node/inventory hashes. Include pinned official Windows header/library inputs when needed, without executing foreign binaries or enabling unqualified targets. Define bounded runtime receipt/inventory/result types and canonical layout without changing public contracts.
acceptanceChecks: All six declared os/arch policy identities retain Node22.22.1/npm10.9.4/header22.22.1 consistency; profile metadata is derived from verified official archive/assets and reproducible, not copied from an installed receipt.
Completion64KiB, inventory16MiB,32768 entries,128MiB/file,1GiB expanded,256MiB/compressed asset,600s network and120s verification bounds are explicit and tested.
RuntimeIdentity/ReleaseManifest/IPC fields remain unchanged; metadata computation alone neither executes target code nor enables a native target.

tasks.title: Implement the read-only verified runtime resolver
tasks.summary: Replace the unused privateRuntimePaths constructor with the approved async resolver, implemented through the proposed runtime-store module. Verify explicit home/full identity, protected canonical root, independent policy-bound inventory and exact Node/npm/header file set, with no allocation or application imports.
acceptanceChecks: Direct calls return frozen canonical absolute runtime paths only for the exact verified identity; tampered files/metadata, extra files, bad target/baseline, links and unsafe roots fail closed.
A self-consistent rewritten receipt/inventory cannot replace the independently pinned expected inventory hash.
Resolver imports no application paths/DB/provider/source builder and performs no network, mkdir, controller lock, selection or application/Ollama traversal.
Task-local fixtures prove this API; production consumer wiring is assessed in t8, not required prematurely for t2 validation.

tasks.title: Acquire and safely stage the official runtime
tasks.summary: Implement bounded live official runtime/header/library download, digest verification and safe deterministic extraction in the proposed acquisition module. Produce only owned validated stages; close actors before cleanup and reuse the read-only verifier/profile rules without application payload access.
acceptanceChecks: Official assets are HTTPS/status/redirect/size/hash/deadline checked before extraction or target-code execution; POSIX and Windows profile extraction rejects unsafe/colliding/special entries and missing exact npm/header/library inputs.
Cancellation and download/extraction failure close network/parser resources before removing only the owned stage; uncertain closure retains evidence and fails.
Stage verification covers the fixed runtime limits and exact independent inventory digest; no runtime/release publication, selection or daemon lifecycle occurs in this staging task.

tasks.title: Publish and reuse runtime entries under controller ownership
tasks.summary: Add immutable durable runtime publication and verified reuse through the existing native operation.lock and original controller capability. Keep executing helper/runtime/DLL paths outside the publication tree and preserve conflicting entries for explicit recovery.
acceptanceChecks: Fresh publication is exclusive and durable under the original live controller lock, with canonical completion/inventory; matching verified entries are reused before network.
Concurrent/stale/lost owners cannot publish; incompatible/incomplete immutable destinations are never overwritten or silently repaired.
Execution and publication stages are distinct, including Windows node.exe/loaded DLL constraints; final-runtime or application cleanup never deletes retained shared runtimes.
No new manager action, lock transfer, PID/kill controller, S4 lifecycle peer or S5 migration implementation is introduced.

tasks.title: Unify terminal bootstrap verification and runtime handoff
tasks.summary: Adapt both shared terminal templates, renderer and publication helper to the same verified external store. Authenticate cached/fresh Node and control bytes before execution, publish under the existing lock, wait for exact helper exit, then invoke the canonical runtime manager with fresh ordinary admission.
acceptanceChecks: Manual and IDE-generated POSIX/PowerShell scripts use fixed independent Node/control digests and need no host Node; matching verified cached runtime/control can work offline while missing prerequisites fail clearly.

The exact publication-helper child exits before the final manager starts/acquires a fresh lock; no inherited lock/session/source flag, PID heuristic or successful install claim substitutes for admission.
Paths with spaces/Unicode/apostrophes, interruption, concurrent bootstrap and Windows nonmoving execution-stage behavior are covered by surrounding fixtures.
Terminal owns prompts/I/O and existing same-terminal TUI semantics; no IDE adapter redesign or current host daemon operation is performed.

tasks.title: Publish and validate application-only bundle format
tasks.summary: Advance private ReleaseDescriptor to format2 without runtimeArchive and adapt bundle inventory, ZIP validation and publisher assembly/probes together. Preserve public manifest1, exact source/target/digests and native qualification while separating runtime acquisition inputs from all app/IDE payload collection.
acceptanceChecks: New bundle/publisher receipts and accepted descriptor hashing consistently use private format2; old embedded descriptor1 is rejected diagnostically without reinterpretation or adoption.
Bundle validation no longer requires tools/node or a runtime archive and still validates the exact production app/native closure and archive safety.
Provenance/allowlisted collection rejects ordinary or renamed Node/Ollama distribution/archive contributions; native .node application dependencies remain legitimate.
Publisher runtime probes and candidate preparation obtain the shared verified external runtime; no release-local/PATH fallback or full app/Ollama reconciliation is added.

tasks.title: Prepare dev candidates with the shared external runtime
tasks.summary: Advance private dev receipts/recipe to application-only semantics and adapt source offers, toolchain, worker staging, verification and immutable publication. Consume the same resolved Node/npm/header/library distribution instead of copying tools/node into dev releases.
acceptanceChecks: Dev receipt2/new recipe, durable offers, canonical hashes and all readers agree; old embedded receipts/offers fail with an explicit compatibility diagnostic.
Dev payloads omit Node/Ollama distributions/archives and preserve exact accepted source, native output closure, closed-worker proof and no duplicate writer.
Dev build commands/owned npm aliases use resolved absolute private Node/npm/header/library paths; existing CUDA skip-if-unset and hostile environment isolation remain.
Prepared candidate open/verify does not acquire/build a runtime implicitly or adopt an arbitrary runtimeDirectory; cross-mode runtime reuse is proven at the shared foundation boundary.

tasks.title: Bind installed consumers to the verified external runtime
tasks.summary: Wire manager/terminal entry, TUI/Retry launch selection, production peer dependency readiness and both delivery modes to real shared resolution/acquisition. Remove process/release-directory guesses and duplicate trust paths, while keeping lifecycle and migration ports under their existing owners. The future Windows bridge process and its runtime-selection/execution coverage remain owned by main-epic S7; this task exposes the shared foundation for that consumer.
acceptanceChecks: Every existing installed consumer owned by this correction selects the canonical resolved executable from explicit location+manifest identity, verifies actual process.execPath where required, and has no tools/node/PATH/runtimeDirectory trust fallback. S4 daemon boot consumes the real exposed resolver later; no S4 production consumer is required prematurely here. Future S7 bridge-process runtime selection/execution is not a current T8 consumer or a prerequisite to validating this task.

Both delivery preparations acquire only under original controller ownership before lifecycle disruption; installed start/status/receipt resolution never downloads/builds source or traverses full app/Ollama payloads.
S3 runtime readiness uses verified external paths, preserving Ollama consent/retention, agent recommendations, install-only Retry and terminal TUI flow.
S4 boot/lease/shutdown/wrapper and S5 hooks remain consumers, not new implementations; separate manager action-specific peer gating is excluded and missing production peers still fail truthfully.

tasks.title: Complete integrated coverage and run the scoped regression
tasks.summary: Finish cross-mode/consumer/regression fixtures and validation-only native harness setup, maintain structured design companions if relationships change, and run the complete scoped installer regression after all source tasks are built. Preserve final human BUILD approval after validation rather than per-task approvals.
acceptanceChecks: All25 LLD subjects and ac1–ac6 have explicit owner mapping. All non-native surrounding/integrated regression evidence passes with canonical Node22 coordinator and confirmed actor cleanup after the last implementation task is built. Actual native evidence belongs to t10 and is neither required prematurely nor claimed by t9.

Surrounding S2/S3/terminal/bridge/public-contract tests preserve source closure, consent/Retry/TUI and no full app/Ollama status/readiness rehash; no test fixture certifies a real unavailable lifecycle/migration peer.

Generated ER retains one runtime ->0..N releases, sequence retains exact helper-exit/fresh-manager ownership ordering, and component/import boundaries match implementation. Source and render checks distinguish unavailable evidence.
Final regression/source checks pass before completion; tracker/build admission failures are reported rather than bypassed with fabricated Define/issue bindings or raw workflow edits.

tasks.title: Record native runtime qualification and S4 handoff evidence
tasks.summary: Record actual macOS/Linux runtime and installed-consumer qualification, current scoped regression and exact source/actor evidence. Reuse retained UTM macOS proof only with recorded production-source equivalence; retain fresh current-source OrbStack Linux evidence. Windows native qualification remains deferred and unqualified. Hand the resolver foundation back to S4 only after current validation and human BUILD approval.
acceptanceChecks: Actual UTM macOS and OrbStack Linux runtime-first-acquisition/native-build/offline-reuse/installed-consumer checks are distinguished from fixtures and host emulation; host v2/Ollama remain untouched. Retained native evidence is reusable only with exact relevant source/build-policy equivalence, pinned runtime/platform identity and verified actor closure; retain its original execution source pin.

Current foundation completion covers macOS/Linux. The original native-Windows-first-install-reuse-named-path-ACL-header-library-and-loaded-DLL-safe-publication subject is deferred, not passed and not a current T10 gate. Windows requires genuine native ACL/path/header/library/loaded-DLL-safe-publication evidence before future enablement; POSIX execution, cross-archive metadata or an availability diagnostic cannot qualify it. ISSUE-cab5701fbefab736 remains its separate process-ownership prerequisite; Windows target publication/enablement stays disabled.
Qualification is for the runtime foundation and existing installed-consumer boundaries; no end-to-end S4/S5 daemon activation proof is fabricated or introduced as a cyclic prerequisite.

No source changes are made during this evidence-only task. Any required correction returns to its owning task and reruns appropriate tests/regression; user BUILD approval is requested only after all required validation/task accounting/tracker gates are satisfied.

epicImpact.findings: Preserve completed budget/controller prerequisites and the foundation's accepted implementation. Main epic lifecycle and later integration remain outside this acceptance revision.

citations.quotedText: Approved revision5 retains revision4 §4.1–4.2: independently pinned official distribution profiles, metadata/types, canonical runtime store and fixed finite bounds; public runtime/manifest contracts unchanged.
§3.2–3.3: privateRuntimePaths is the verified async read-only resolver; exact runtime integrity and explicit home, no allocation/acquisition/application imports or arbitrary runtimeDirectory trust.
§4.3: live official bounded download/safe stage; controller-owned immutable publication, exact verified reuse and closed actors, using original native operation.lock ownership.

§3.4/§4.3: shared POSIX/PowerShell bootstrap verifies Node/control bytes before execution, publishes a nonexecuting stage, observes exact helper exit before fresh manager admission, including Windows loaded DLL constraints.

§4.4: private descriptor2/application-only inventory and publisher/probe adaptation; reject embedded formats and runtime byte contributions while preserving public manifest1 and native closure/qualification.
§4.4–4.5: dev receipt2/new recipe and canonical offers/readers with shared external Node/npm/header/library; retain accepted source, worker closure and owned native build environment.

§4.5: existing manager/terminal/TUI/Retry/bootstrap/dependency readiness and delivery/publisher consumers use the real shared foundation; future S7 bridge process/runtime execution remains with S7. No installed source build or release-local/PATH fallback.

Approved revision5 §7:21 unchanged non-live subjects plus actual UTM macOS, OrbStack Linux and unqualified-target exclusion (24 current subjects), mapped to ac1–ac6. The original Windows native subject is explicitly deferred and remains required before future Windows enablement. Source-pinned evidence reuse requires relevant production/build-policy equivalence and closure proof.

§6/§8: fail closed on corrupt runtime/legacy format/ownership/closure; preserve consent/install-only Retry, same-terminal TUI, current host daemon and immutable entries; unavailable native evidence is not a pass. User requires final story BUILD approval after all tasks.

§4.6 and diagrams: standalone ISSUE correction with external epic compatibility references only; S4 boot/control/lease/wrapper, S5 hooks and action-specific peer gating stay with their existing owners. Runtime-to-release cardinality and helper handoff sources retained. Future Windows bridge implementation and execution coverage remain with S7.
